$comment: The tool list for the ambiguous-dynamic SureX review fixture. Every entry here becomes an MCP tool at startup. The server source does not name any of them — that is what this fixture is for. An entry may only pick a kind from the closed set implemented in server.mjs: static-text, list-notes, count-lines. An entry naming anything else is refused at load time and never registered. Everything shipped here is harmless.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Returns this build's release note, exactly as written in tools.config.json.
tools.text: ambiguous-dynamic 0.1.0 — a SureX review fixture. The tool you just called was declared in tools.config.json, not in the server source. Restarting with a different file gives you a different server, from the same reviewed bytes.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: Lists the note files in this fixture's own notes directory. Names and sizes only.

tools.name: note_line_count
tools.description: Counts the lines in one note from this fixture's own notes directory.
